digest.component_or_area: tickets store fsck remediation and integrity
propositions: The tickets store contains 561 pre-existing fsck diagnostics: 550 SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL, 10 ORPHAN_EVENT (all AUTO-RECOVER LINK type), and 1 intentional STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED audit record.

Scoped fsck repair via --repair --only=stale-channel must be implemented to selectively repair stale-channel findings while refusing mixed-fault tickets and preserving legacy unfiltered --repair behavior.
Orphan event repair must complete first via the existing AUTO-RECOVER path, followed by resumable stale-channel repair in batches with --limit, all commits and pushes deferred to the batch driver.
Post-repair fsck must report exactly zero repairable findings (zero SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL, zero ORPHAN_EVENT) while retaining the four intentional STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED audit records.
The remediation must execute during a quiet maintenance window after verifying writer quiescence, with pre-repair bundle verification and rollback capability preserved.

Live execution produced four repair commits that remediated all 561 diagnostics: orphan repair plus three stale-channel batches, confirmed by independent post-repair fsck with zero repairable findings.
